identity.name: Cygnus X-1
identity.description: X-ray binary, first black hole candidate (21.2 solar masses). Transform unit: light-year. Rounded values, to cross-check.

identity.name: Cygnus X-1 black hole
identity.description: Stellar-mass black hole, 21.2 solar masses, Schwarzschild radius 62.5 km (apparent shadow 2.6x, drawn by the lens). Transform unit: kilometre.

identity.name: Sagittarius A
identity.description: Galactic centre region. Transform unit: light-year.

identity.name: Sagittarius A*
identity.description: Supermassive black hole, 4.3 million solar masses, Schwarzschild radius 1.27e7 km (0.085 AU); accretion disc 1.5 to 20 Schwarzschild radii (inner edge artistic, glued to the shadow; inclination arbitrary). Transform unit: kilometre.

identity.name: Crab Pulsar
identity.description: PSR B0531+21, neutron star of the Crab Nebula (supernova of 1054), spin 33.5 ms. Transform unit: light-year. Rounded values, to cross-check.

identity.name: Crab Pulsar neutron star
identity.description: Neutron star, 1.4 solar masses, radius ~12 km, with two polar jets spinning with the star (spin slowed to 2 rad/s for readability, real period 33.5 ms; jet length and 45 deg magnetic inclination are artistic). Transform unit: kilometre.
